sentences.en: So, hello everyone.
sentences.zh: 那么，大家好。

sentences.en: My name's Lou Miller and I'm going to be your tour guide today as we take this fantastic boat trip around the Tasmanian coast.
sentences.zh: 我叫露·米勒，今天将担任你们的导游，带大家乘坐这艘精彩的游船环游塔斯马尼亚海岸。

sentences.en: Before we set off, I just want to tell you a few things about our journey.
sentences.zh: 在出发之前，我想先向大家简要介绍一下本次行程。

sentences.en: Our boats aren't huge as you can see.
sentences.zh: 我们的船并不大，大家可以看到。

sentences.en: We already have three staff members on board and on top of that, we can transport a further fifteen people – that' s you – around the coastline.
sentences.zh: 船上已有三名工作人员，此外还可搭载十五名乘客——也就是各位——沿海岸线游览。

sentences.en: But please note if there are more than nine people on either side of the boat, we'll move some of you over, otherwise all eighteen of us will end up in the sea!
sentences.zh: 但请注意：如果船体任一侧人数超过九人，我们将安排部分乘客换到另一侧，否则我们十八个人都会掉进海里！

sentences.en: We've recently upgraded all our boats.
sentences.zh: 我们最近对所有船只进行了升级。

sentences.en: They used to be jet black, but our new ones now have these comfortable dark red seats and a light-green exterior in order to stand out from others and help promote our company.
sentences.zh: 以前的船是喷漆成纯黑色的，而新船则配备了舒适的深红色座椅，并采用浅绿色船体外观，以便与其他船只区分开来，并有助于推广我们的公司。

sentences.en: This gives our boats a rather unique appearance, don't you think?
sentences.zh: 这让我们的船只呈现出相当独特的外观，您不这么认为吗？

sentences.en: We offer you a free lunchbox during the trip and we have three types.
sentences.zh: 旅途中我们会为各位免费提供午餐盒，共有三种类型。

sentences.en: Lunchbox 1 contains ham and tomato sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 1号午餐盒包含火腿番茄三明治。

sentences.en: Lunchbox 2 contains a cheddar cheese roll and Lunchbox 3 is salad-based and also contains eggs and tuna.
sentences.zh: 2号午餐盒包含切达奶酪卷，3号午餐盒以沙拉为主，还含有鸡蛋和金枪鱼。

sentences.en: All three lunchboxes also have a packet of crisps and chocolate bar inside.
sentences.zh: 这三种午餐盒内均配有薯片一包和巧克力一条。

sentences.en: Please let staff know which lunchbox you prefer.
sentences.zh: 请告知工作人员您偏好的午餐盒类型。

sentences.en: I'm sure I don't have to ask you not to throw anything into the sea.
sentences.zh: 我相信我不必特别提醒大家不要向海中丢弃任何物品。

sentences.en: We don't have any bins to put litter in, but Jess, myself or Ray, our other guide, will collect it from you after lunch and put it all in a large plastic sack.
sentences.zh: 船上没有垃圾桶可投放垃圾，但杰西、我本人或另一位导游雷会在午餐后向各位收集垃圾，并统一装入一个大型塑料袋中。

sentences.en: The engine on the boat makes quite a lot of noise so before we head of f, let me tell you a few things about what you're going to see.
sentences.zh: 船用发动机噪音较大，因此在启航前，让我先为大家简要介绍一下沿途将看到的景观。

sentences.en: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts This area is famous for its ancient lighthouse, which you'll see from the boat as we turn past the first little island.
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 听力原文 这一地区以一座古老的灯塔而闻名，当我们绕过第一座小岛时，大家可在船上看到它。

sentences.en: It was built in 1838 to protect sailors as a number of shipwrecks had led to significant loss of life .
sentences.zh: 该灯塔建于1838年，旨在保护航海者安全，因为此前多起海难已造成大量人员伤亡。

sentences.en: The construction itself was complicated as some of the original drawings kept by the local council show.
sentences.zh: 其建造过程本身十分复杂，当地议会保存的部分原始设计图纸便可证明这一点。

sentences.en: It sits right on top of the cliffs in a very isolated spot.
sentences.zh: 灯塔矗立于悬崖顶端，地处极为偏僻。

sentences.en: In the nineteenth century there were many jobs there, such as polishing the brass lamps, chopping firewood and cleaning windows, that kept lighthouse keepers busy .
sentences.zh: 十九世纪时，灯塔内有许多工作，例如擦拭黄铜灯罩、劈柴以及擦洗窗户等，这些活计让灯塔看守员始终忙碌不停。

sentences.en: These workers were mainly prison convicts until the middle of that century when ordinary families willing to live in such circumstances took over.
sentences.zh: 这些工人起初主要是囚犯，直到该世纪中叶，才由愿意在这种环境下生活的普通家庭接替。

sentences.en: Some of you have asked me what creatures we can expect to see.
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人曾问我，此行可能见到哪些动物。

sentences.en: I know everyone loves the penguins, but they're very shy and, unfortunately, tend to hide from passing boats, but you might see birds in the distance, such as sea eagles, flying around the clif f edges where they nest.
sentences.zh: 我知道大家都很喜欢企鹅，但它们非常胆小，不幸的是，通常会躲避开驶过的船只；不过，你们或许能在远处看到一些鸟类，比如白尾海雕，它们在悬崖边缘筑巢并盘旋飞翔。

sentences.en: When we get to the rocky area inhabited by fur seals, we'll stop and watch them swimming around the coast.
sentences.zh: 当我们抵达栖息着毛皮海豹的岩岸区域时，我们将停船观察它们在海岸附近游泳。

sentences.en: They're inquisitive creatures so don't be surprised if one pops up right in front of you.
sentences.zh: 这些动物好奇心很强，所以如果突然有一只海豹直接浮现在你面前，也请不必惊讶。

sentences.en: Their predators, orca whales, hunt along the coastline too, but spotting one of these is rare.
sentences.zh: 它们的天敌——逆戟鲸——也会沿着海岸线捕猎，但目击到这种动物的机会极为罕见。

sentences.en: Dolphins, on the other hand, can sometimes approach on their own or in groups as they ride the waves beside us.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，海豚有时会单独或成群主动靠近我们，伴着船边涌起的浪花游弋。

sentences.en: Lastly, I want to mention the caves.
sentences.zh: 最后，我想提一下洞穴。

sentences.en: Tasmania is famous for its caves and the ones we'll pass by are so amazing that people are lost for words when they see them.
sentences.zh: 塔斯马尼亚以洞穴闻名，而我们将途经的这些洞穴如此壮观，以至于人们初见时往往惊叹得说不出话来。

sentences.en: They can only be approached by sea, but if you feel that you want to see more than we're able to show you, then you can take a kayak into the area on another day and one of our staff will give you more information on that.
sentences.zh: 这些洞穴只能从海上接近；若您希望看到比本次行程所能展示的更多内容，可另择一日租用皮划艇进入该区域，届时我们的工作人员会为您提供更详细的资讯。

sentences.en: What we'll do is to go through a narrow channel, past some incredible rock formations and from there we'll be able to see the openings to the caves, and at that point we'll talk to you about what lies beyond.
sentences.zh: 我们的路线是穿过一条狭窄水道，经过一些令人叹为观止的岩石构造，随后即可看到洞穴入口；到达此处时，我们将向大家介绍洞穴内部的景象。
